messages.content: 4-Stage Attack Vector Confirmed. TTPs match APT-POSEIDON: Stage 1: Spear-phishing Kongsberg update PDF. Stage 2: CVE-2024-28921 DNP3 zero-day pivot. Stage 3: Siemens S7-1500 firmware implant. Stage 4: Coordinated trigger.
